supply_qualification.basis: Board RF supply mode is neither inferred nor configured by RTC. The generic RTC qualification uses the intersection of both own-table supply ranges. Deferring RF peripheral support does not establish RF-LDO board mode.

upstream.api_basis: Ownership, bounded Result API; no STM32 register protocol imported

boundaries.classic_lsi: 32,800 / 32,768 calendar ticks per SI second at nominal; source-qualified RC timing, not exact wall clock
boundaries.initialization: LSI acquisition never writes trim. A current non-factory trim or erased factory halfword is rejected before any enable write; LSIEN=0 is not treated as proof of quiescence. Board/bootloader must establish calibration before this HAL capability is requested.
boundaries.running_set: Classic WINDOW->ACCESS; L010 WAIT->ACCESS->WINDOW; fixed-size date/time writes under short interrupt masking; no STOP command or rollback guarantee
boundaries.access_timing: Classic wait uses minimum10ms spacing from maximum HCLK ClockBounds, capped at1000 attempts outside ACCESS. L010 uses at most32 status reads while ACCESS is held and ordinary interrupts are masked. This is bounded work, not a proven wall-clock WCET; the user must meet the manual one-second transaction precondition. Debugger/NMI/bus stalls and silicon deadline behavior remain unverified.
